# `conflicts` operations

The exact fields each `conflicts.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `conflicts.allowlist_list`

List (memory_key, memory_key) pairs marked as known-non-conflicting so the conflicts worker stops flagging them.

`POST /v1/conflicts.allowlist_list` · MCP `loom_conflicts_allowlist_list` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `limit` | `int` | `100` | At most this many pairs, 1-1000, newest first. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `list[_AllowlistRow]` | Live allowed key pairs (`memory_key_a` sorts before `memory_key_b`), newest first. |

## `conflicts.allowlist_remove`

Revoke an allow decision; the pair will re-flag on future writes.

`POST /v1/conflicts.allowlist_remove` · MCP `loom_conflicts_allowlist_remove` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `memory_key_a` | `str` | required | One key of the allowed pair; the order of the two keys does not matter. |
| `memory_key_b` | `str` | required | The other key of the pair. |
| `removed_by` | `str` | `''` | Who revoked it; appended with `reason` to the pair's stored reason. |
| `reason` | `str` | `''` | Why; appended to the pair's stored reason. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `removed` | `bool` | False when no live allowed pair matched. |

## `conflicts.list`

List unresolved conflicts where two memories contradict each other.

`POST /v1/conflicts.list` · MCP `loom_conflicts_list` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | At most this many rows, 1-500, newest version first. |
| `before_version` | `int \| None` | `None` | Keyset cursor — pass previous response's earliest version to paginate. |
| `count_only` | `bool` | `False` | A badge needs the number, not the rows. |
| `fresh` | `bool` | `False` | With count_only, count now instead of reading the minute-long cache; default off. |
| `keys_only` | `bool` | `False` | The Memories view marks cards that have a conflict and needs only the keys. |
| `fields` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | The output fields the caller reads (a whitelist resolved against the row model; an unknown name is a 422); unset, every field. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `list[_ConflictRow]` | Conflicted memories, newest version first; empty on a `count_only` or `keys_only` call. |
| `next_before_version` | `int \| None` | Pass as `before_version` for the next page; null on the last page. |
| `total` | `int \| None` | The live conflicted count for the namespace; set on a count_only call. |
| `keys` | `list[str] \| None` | The conflicted memory keys of the namespace; set on a keys_only call. |

## `conflicts.propose_revision`

Return non-destructive revise/contract/allow suggestions.

`POST /v1/conflicts.propose_revision` · MCP `loom_conflicts_propose_revision` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `memory_id` | `str` | required | The conflicted memory to advise on (an org-wide id). |
| `peer_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | Limit the advice to this one peer from its `conflict_with`; None considers every peer. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the memory, or every row it names, is not live in `namespace`. |
| `memories` | `list[_ConflictCandidateMemory]` | The target first (`local_id` 1), then its live peers, newest first. |
| `suggestions` | `list[_ConflictRevisionSuggestion]` | At most one suggested `conflicts.resolve`, by local id: revise when the target is pinned or shares a peer's key, contract when a peer is pinned, else allow. |
| `note` | `str` | Always says that nothing was applied: this operation only advises. |

## `conflicts.resolve`

Pick the winner of a conflict (keep A, keep B, keep both, merge).

`POST /v1/conflicts.resolve` · MCP `loom_conflicts_resolve` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `memory_id` | `str` | required | The conflicted memory the decision is about (an org-wide id); it must live in `namespace`. |
| `decision` | `Literal['revise', 'contract', 'allow']` | required | `revise` keeps it and tombstones the peers; `contract` tombstones it and reactivates the peers; `allow` reactivates all and allowlists each key pair. |
| `peer_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | Optional: scope the resolve to one specific peer (revise against just that one). |
| `reason` | `str` | `''` | Why; appended to tombstoned rows' `source_trace` and stored on allowlist rows (first 512 characters). |
| `resolved_by` | `str` | `''` | Who resolved it, recorded beside `reason` (first 128 characters); not checked against the token. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resolved` | `bool` | False when the memory or the named peer is unknown, or the memory is not in `namespace`; nothing was written then. |
| `decision` | `Literal['revise', 'contract', 'allow']` | The decision, echoed. |
| `affected_memory_ids` | `list[str]` | Every memory id this call tombstoned or reactivated. |
| `resolved_at` | `datetime \| None` | When the resolve ran (UTC); null when nothing was resolved. |
| `total` | `int \| None` | The namespace's conflicted count under the caller's read scope, counted after the writes; null when nothing was resolved or the count failed. |
